newsitem.title: USA: Alcoa seeks buyer for Caradco window unit.
newsitem.headline: Alcoa seeks buyer for Caradco window unit.

text.p: The Aluminum Company of America (Alcoa) is seeking a buyer for its Caradco Inc subsidiary, a window manufacturer based in Illinois, Caradco said Wednesday.
The company said it has not yet set a timetable for the divestiture, but visits by potential buyers will begin in the near term.
Caradco said the company is seeking a buyer with interests in the window and door markets.

"Strong demand exists for our products," said Alan Verploegh, president of Caradco. "We believe that Caradco can grow most effectively and provide the service and products our customers need if we become part of a company which is significantly and strategically focused on our window and door industry."
